header: Reading, licensing and citing our research

items.tab_content: A Reader seat is EUR 12 per month for one person. Practitioner at EUR 29 adds citation exports and the monthly methods briefing. Institutions take 250 concurrent seats for EUR 6,400 a year.
Everything appears under CC BY-NC 4.0. Non-commercial reuse needs attribution and nothing more; commercial requests are quoted by the rights desk, usually inside five working days.
Issue 2026/2 added 312 papers and opened 289 older ones to public access. Saved searches re-run overnight and mail you what changed.
